paragraph: He was a little old man with **thick** glasses. That book is **thick**, but it's not very expensive. The ice was so **thick** as to walk on.
english: relatively great in extent from one surface to another

paragraph: What **percentage** of the students are admitted to colleges? What **percentage** of the students in your class are girls? What **percentage** of the American population lives near the coast?
english: the amount, number or rate of something, regarded as part of a total of 100

paragraph: Dr. **Miller** wants you to wait for a while. Every **miller** draws water to his own mill. Good morning, Mr **Miller**. Please, have a seat.
english: a person who owns or operates a mill, especially a flourmill

paragraph: I'm a very **stable** genius. She chose the most spirited horse in the **stable**. A **stable** economy is the aim of every government.
english: a building, wing or dependency set apart and adapted for lodging and feeding (and training) ungulates, especially horses
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا عبقري مستقر جدا عقليا.

paragraph: The quiet cat caught the **mouse**. Now, he's hiding like a **mouse**. The cat slowly approached the **mouse**.
english: rodent of the genus Mus

paragraph: Can you pick a lock with a paper **clip**? Don't start that again, or you'll get a **clip** round the ear! Do we have a paper **clip**?
english: something which clips or grasps

paragraph: They **assigned** the task to us. I have to **assign** more men to that work. Ask your teacher and he will **assign** you one.
english: to designate or set apart (something) for some purpose

paragraph: He even asked me if I would **marry** him. I want to **marry** a girl like her. If I don't **marry** you, I'll never **marry**.
english: to unite in wedlock
arabicDesc: مثال: بل و سألني أيضا إن كنت راغبة في الزّواج منه.

paragraph: In the **sequence** of life, we face many challenges. Nobody could remember the **sequence** of events. Each sheet bears a number in **sequence**.
english: a set of things next to each other in a set order

paragraph: He hurt his left hand with a **knife**. It can be used as a **knife**. I have no **knife** to cut with.
english: utensil or tool designed for cutting

other.meaning: any blade-like part designed for cutting

paragraph: Today I got to meet my new **philosophy** teacher. The first subject that attracted my attention was **philosophy**. The great critic and poet is lecturing on **philosophy**.
english: a view or outlook regarding fundamental principles underlying some domain

paragraph: I want to be a sport **reporter**. The interview between the **reporter** and the students was funny. The **reporter** took down everything that was said.
english: journalist
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد أن أصبح مراسلا رياضيا.

paragraph: We don't have **wolves** in the area. **Wolves** won't usually attack people. While walking in the forest, I saw a **wolf**.
english: canis lupus
arabicDesc: مثال: ليست لدينا ذئاب في المنطقة.

paragraph: There is a **pen** between the apple and the book. She took a **pen** out of her pocket. She took the **pen** and wrote the address.
english: writing tool
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك سيالة بين التفاحة و الكتاب.

paragraph: Would you put this in the safety **deposit** box? I gave him a **deposit** and then he disappeared. I forgot the code for the safe **deposit** box.
english: sediment or rock that is not native to its present location or is different from the surrounding material. Sometimes refers to ore or gems

paragraph: Do you have experience working with **graphic** design software? He is a **graphic** designer for a video game company. You will need a **graphic** card to play this game.
english: drawn, pictorial

paragraph: When was the last time you bought **bread**? Tell me which **bread** you want to eat. Mother went to town to get some **bread**.
english: baked dough made from cereals
arabicDesc: مثال: متى كانت آخر مرّة اشتريت فيها الخبز؟

paragraph: This is the village where I spent my **childhood**. I wish I could get back to my **childhood** again. This park reminds me of my **childhood**.
english: state of being a child
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه هي القرية التي عشت فيها طفولتي.

paragraph: We're planning to start a new **clinical** study. I made a huge **clinical** error. The doctor applied the **clinical** guidelines for the treatment.
english: relating to treating patients

paragraph: This doesn't **entitle** you to yell at me. How long of a break are workers **entitled** to? We are **entitled** to vote at the age of 20.
english: to give someone the right to something; to give a title

paragraph: For all her **wealth**, she does not look happy. I don't have much desire for **wealth**. Health is more important than **wealth**.
english: riches; valuable material possessions
arabicDesc: مثال: على الرغم من ثرائها إلا أنها لا تبدو سعيدة.

paragraph: The **developers** quickly fixed the bug. What could you suggest to the **developer** of the application? I think he's a good **developer** but a bad project manager.
english: software programmer

paragraph: I have a first aid **kit** in the bathroom. What should I keep in my first aid **kit**? The first-aid **kit** is under the driving seat.
english: a set of tools or parts

paragraph: They stole my **lover** and all the colors of happiness. Do you have a **lover**? My secret **lover** is on his way for me.
english: one who loves and cares for another person in a romantic way
arabicDesc: مثال: سرقوا مني حبيبتي و كل ألوان الفرحة.

paragraph: This mystery has a plot **twist** that's completely novel. Did he **twist** the facts to suit his narrative? Remember to **twist** the handle and stop the water flow.
english: to turn the ends in opposite directions

paragraph: I serve on a **jury** about once a year. She stood in the court before judge and **jury**. It's my duty to go serve on that **jury**.
english: a group of individuals chosen from the general population to hear and decide a case in a court of law
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: هيئة محلفين، لجنة، لجنة تحكيم

other.meaning: group of judges in a competition

paragraph: My mum is about to take a **bath**. I take a **bath** almost every day. After taking a **bath**, I drank juice.
english: a tub or pool which is used for bathing: bathtub

other.meaning: building or area where bathing occurs
A number of places in the United States: (noun)

paragraph: What is the meaning of fighting without a **sacrifice**? This job position demands a lot of personal **sacrifice**. A good **sacrifice** is a **sacrifice** that is not.
english: originally, the killing (and often burning) of a human being or an animal as an offering to a deity

other.meaning: To offer (a human being or an animal, or an object) to a deity (verb)

paragraph: He tries to **impress** his friends. I won't buy it since it doesn't **impress** me. I have to put makeup on to **impress** him.
english: to make someone admire you

paragraph: You are my only **resort**. This summer **resort** is no longer as popular as it used to be. She relied on the medicine as a last **resort**.
english: a relaxing environment for people on vacation

paragraph: Mr **Ford** owns this land. My car is a **Ford**, just like yours. Never praise a **ford** till you get over.
english: a make of a car
arabicDesc: مثال: السيد فورد يملك هذه الأرض.

paragraph: I want to **execute** the plan by all means. We all thought it difficult to **execute** the plan. Whose plan will be the hardest to **execute**?
english: to kill, especially as punishment for a capital crime

paragraph: He **hopped** into the river. I don't like being caught on the **hop**. I need you to **hop** that wall.
english: a short jump

paragraph: The **hunter** was alert to every sound and movement. The **hunter** explored the appearance of the sky. He is a **hunter** who only hunts himself.
english: person who hunts game

paragraph: Tell her that I am **breast**-feeding my baby. I'm not a different woman because of **breast** cancer. Did you know that men can get **breast** cancer?
english: either of the two organs on the front of a female human's chest, which contain the mammary glands

paragraph: His book begins with a **tale** of country life. Don't expect me to believe such a tall **tale**. I authored a **tale** and won the contest.
english: type of story

paragraph: No one can **predict** exactly what surprises are in store tonight. The old man **predicted** our success. No one could have **predicted** this.
english: to state, or make something known in advance
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أحد بإمكانه التّنبّؤ بالمفاجآت المقرّرة لهذا المساء.

paragraph: I give you five minutes to **resolve** this issue. What's the best way to **resolve** the problem? She hopes to be able to **resolve** this problem.
english: to find a solution to
arabicDesc: مثال: أُعطيك خَمس دقائق لحل هذه المشكلة.

paragraph: In the United States, **coal** makes 39% of our electricity. They are loading **coal** into a ship now. He grabbed hot **coal**, his fingers got burned.
english: a black or brownish black rock formed from prehistoric plant remains, composed largely of carbon and burned as a fuel

paragraph: The **jets** took off one after another. We saw a **jet** plane fly across the sky. Two **jet** planes took off at the same time.
english: a collimated stream, spurt or flow of liquid or gas from a pressurized container, an engine, etc
arabicDesc: مثال: أقلعت الطائرات النفاثة واحدة تلو الأخرى.

other.meaning: To spray out of a container (verb)

paragraph: The **recommendation** from my boss made all the difference. My **recommendation** is that you invest in government bonds. He wrote letters of **recommendation** for a few students.
english: an act of recommending

paragraph: Every day, I spend hours doing nothing of **import**. **Import** goods are subject to high taxes. Tax revenues come mainly from **import** duties.
english: to bring in from a foreign country

paragraph: These he used to **distribute** to his friends. The soldiers **distribute** food to the refugees. The media doesn't **distribute** the news.
english: to divide into portions and dispense

paragraph: He didn't get a **promotion**. You're the next in line for **promotion**, aren't you? Why didn't you tell me you took the **promotion**?
english: advancement in position

paragraph: Don't forget that there are **exceptions**. Very well, we'll make an **exception** in your case. I don't think that we should make an **exception**.
english: the act of excepting or excluding
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تنس أنّه توجد حالات استثنائيّة.

paragraph: I haven't used this **pot** in a long time. Why is the **pot** broken? Who threw this down? The big cooking **pot** is on the kitchen table.
english: a flat-bottomed vessel (usually metal) used for cooking food, possibly excluding saucepans (see usage notes)

paragraph: My **script** should be ready in half an hour. Overall, the movie was a success from **script** to screen. Man has never read the **script** of life.
english: a writing

other.meaning: text of the dialogue and action for a drama

paragraph: I plan to invite a lot of guests to the opening **ceremony**. Can I come to the **ceremony**? He didn't attend the **ceremony**.
english: official gathering to celebrate
arabicDesc: مثال: أخطط لدعوة ضيوف كثيرين إلى حفل الافتتاح.

paragraph: This **virus** is a problem all over the world. We'll have to learn to live with the **virus**. We have no evidence that such a **virus** exists.
english: a quantity of such infectious agents, considered en masse

paragraph: She takes great **pride** in her appearance. He takes **pride** in his son. **Pride** comes before the fall.
english: sense of one's own worth, and abhorrence of what is beneath or unworthy of one

paragraph: I do not have an account in these **forums**. More than four hundred people participated in the **forum**. You are not on this **forum** to learn languages.
english: place for discussion
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس عندي حساب في هذه المنتديات.

paragraph: He was **educated** at a public school. Those who have no children **educate** them well. I sacrificed a lot in order to **educate** my daughter.
english: to instruct or train

paragraph: Does the **tube** train stop at the next station? Get the **tube**, and you'll get to hospital quicker. How many stations has this **tube** line got?
english: anything that is hollow and cylindrical in shape

paragraph: It was a **fairly** cool night. All things considered, she is a **fairly** good wife. It is **fairly** warm for this period of time.
english: in a fair manner

paragraph: The way you treat others reflects your **inner** beauty. Her **inner** strength is an example to us all. My **inner** voice was clear, but I silenced it.
english: close to the centre, located near or closer to center

paragraph: He has a **monthly** income of 2,000 dollars. He intends to bring out a new **monthly** magazine. The **monthly** staff meeting is never held on Monday.
english: occurring every month
arabicDesc: مثال: لديه راتب شهري يبلغ 2000 دولار.

paragraph: I have a lot of work still **outstanding**. An individual course of study is good for **outstanding** students. I think the visual quality is **outstanding**.
english: excellent; also not yet paid or done

paragraph: We need to get **rid** of the guards. I want to get **rid** of it. Try to get **rid** of them.
english: to remove something unwanted (get rid of)

paragraph: The belt became a **symbol** of fear for me. The bat is considered a **symbol** of good luck. A flag is a **symbol** of the people.
english: object meant to represent another

paragraph: My brother has become a **priest**. You look a little young to be a **priest**. The **priest** blessed the marriage of the happy couple.
english: a religious clergyman (clergywoman, clergyperson) who is trained to perform services or sacrifices at a church or temple

paragraph: No matter how **rough** things get, we'll survive somehow. This is a **rough** world we are living in. He ended up sleeping **rough** in a market town.
english: not smooth

paragraph: Do you need any help, **buddy**? The good **buddy** is only recognized during the storm. I caught him in bed with my best **buddy**.
english: an informal word for a friend

paragraph: That **desert** looks like the surface of the moon. Would you like to go to a **desert** island? He knows how to find water in the **desert**.
english: a barren area of land or desolate terrain, especially one with little water or vegetation

other.meaning: To leave (anything that depends on one's presence to survive, exist, or succeed), especially when contrary to a promise or obligation (verb)

paragraph: My father gives my mother all of his **salary**. The **salary** will go up starting in April. I don't think many people can say they are satisfied with their **salary**.
english: money paid every month for a job
arabicDesc: مثال: أبي يعطي أمي كل راتبه الشهري.

paragraph: The drink I usually have has changed its **formula**. This **formula** is the basis of the theory. He did a commercial for a baby **formula**.
english: any mathematical rule expressed symbolically

paragraph: The **auto** was in the middle of the road. Our car is being repaired at the **auto** shop. This singer uses **auto**-tune to alter his voice.
english: a car; also automatic

paragraph: That **celebrity** married couple adopted a child of every race. The **celebrity** spoke out against single-use plastics. If you saw a **celebrity**, what would you ask them?
english: fame, renown

paragraph: Are you ready to meet your **maker**? It's not an easy thing to meet your **maker**. He is the sole decision-**maker** in this company.
english: someone who makes
arabicDesc: مثال: هل أنت مستعد للقاء خالقك؟

paragraph: I **owe** my success to their help. I **owe** it you that I am still alive. I **owe** what I am today to my parents.
english: to have to pay money back; to be grateful for something
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا مدينٌ بنجاحي لهم لمساعدتهم لي.

paragraph: I know. I've thought about how to **pace** myself. We have not kept **pace** with the latest research. You're really taking your time. Pick up the **pace**!
english: the speed of walking or of an activity

paragraph: Can it fit on the head of a **pin**? This push **pin** is supplied with the repair kit. Are you trying to **pin** the blame on me?
english: a small nail with a head and a sharp point

paragraph: How do you **incorporate** language learning into your travels? **Incorporate** strength training exercises into your routine. **Incorporate** dates into your meals.
english: to include (something) as a part

paragraph: The poet expressed his burning **passion** for the woman he loved. **Passion** grew in their hearts. She has only one great **passion** in life, dancing.
english: any great emotion
arabicDesc: مثال: عبّر الشاعر عن رغبته الحارقة للمرأة التي أحبها.

paragraph: Where is the **boundary** between your field and his field? It is beyond the **boundary** of human knowledge. The mission took the direct route by air to the **boundary**.
english: the dividing line or location between two areas

paragraph: Is she a British **actress** or an American one? The lady dressed in white is a famous **actress**. It was said that that lady was an **actress**.
english: a female who performs on the stage or in films

paragraph: The **membership** numbers of our association keep on increasing. The target date for **membership** is not being given. How much is the **membership** fee for your gym?
english: the state of being a member of a group or organization

paragraph: Don't act like a **bull** in a china shop. A **bull** is male and a cow is female. We need to grab the **bull** by the horns.
english: an adult male, specifically:

paragraph: This watch is **superior** to that one. I will judge whether it is **superior** or not. You think you're **superior** to me in every way.
english: higher in rank, status, or quality
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه الساعة أفضل من تلك.

paragraph: Would you stop **banging** over there? What was the universe like before the Big **Bang**? You get more **bang** for your buck that way.
english: a sudden percussive noise
arabicDesc: مثال: هلاّ توقّفت عن إحداث ضجّة هناك؟

paragraph: The water is **crystal** clear. I found a beautiful **crystal** on the beach last year. There is a big **crystal** in his room.
english: a piece of glimmering, shining mineral resembling ice or glass

paragraph: The **participants** were for the most part young people. The photo shows a group of the congress **participants**. People are disappointed at the number of angry **participants**.
english: one who participates

paragraph: My sister and I went to the **castle**. There used to be a small **castle** on this hill. The old **castle** is a popular tourist attraction.
english: fortified building
arabicDesc: مثال: ذهبت مع أختي إلى القلعة.

paragraph: Please be careful not to let the dog **loose**. That dog is too dangerous to be left **loose**. We need to tie up a few **loose** ends.
english: not fixed in place tightly or firmly

paragraph: Cleaning fish can **gross** out a lot of people. I'm sorry, but the food is totally **gross**. What was the **gross** income in the previous calendar year?
english: remarkably great, big, vast in an often unpleasant way

other.meaning: lacking refinement in manner; offending morality

paragraph: The **investor** stole the capital of his client. She is not the founder, she's the **investor**. The big **investor** bought up the stocks.
english: a person who invests money in order to make a profit

paragraph: Do you think I am **nuts**? The last person I told my idea to thought I was **nuts**. He wants us to think he is a tough **nut**.
english: any of various hard-shelled seeds or hard, dry fruits from various families of plants

paragraph: The Dark **Knight** is a good movie. One was a **knight** and the other was a cook. After the victory, the **knight** was appointed as a general.
english: warrior, especially of the Middle Ages

paragraph: Why didn't anyone **warn** me? I've tried to **warn** you. She **warned** the children not to play on the street.
english: to make someone aware of impending danger

paragraph: Children love to play in the **soil**. The roots are in full contact with the **soil**. The farmer tilled the **soil** in the bottom field.
english: a mixture of mineral particles and organic material, used to support plant growth
arabicDesc: مثال: يحب الأطفال اللعب في التراب.

paragraph: I don't think he's playing with a full **deck**. The weather was calm and everyone was on **deck**. I think the **deck** is missing a few cards.
english: any raised flat surface that can be walked on: a balcony

paragraph: I can **barely** hear him. I had **barely** got home when the storm broke. He can **barely** afford to get the car fixed.
english: by a small margin

paragraph: This book will help you learn to write **effectively**. Studying how to communicate **effectively** is time well spent. You need to learn how to manage your time **effectively**.
english: in a way that works well

paragraph: She has **extensive** knowledge of birds, flowers, and plants. Flash flooding caused **extensive** damage to the low lying neighborhood. Thank you for the detailed and **extensive** reply.
english: large in amount or area

paragraph: It was a **historic** decision. The situation in the **historic** center is relatively stable. He has purchased a **historic** farm from the country.
english: important in history

paragraph: **Initially**, not a single person had faith in you. It was much more difficult than we **initially** thought. I **initially** had trouble understanding what he was saying.
english: at first

paragraph: Music is a **universal** language. Let's make food a common language and a **universal** right. The **universal** library contains every book ever written.
english: a characteristic or property that particular things have in common

paragraph: The desert is **vast** with very few sign posts. A **vast** majority of people approve of the plan. He has a **vast** knowledge of music theory.
english: very large or wide (literally or figuratively)

paragraph: He demanded a **replacement** for the broken part. I had knee **replacement** surgery three months ago. We need to find a **replacement** for him.
english: a person or thing that takes the place of another

paragraph: This suit makes you look so **thin**. There was **thin** ice on the lake. Do you want to get **thin**?
english: having little thickness or extent from one surface to its opposite
arabicDesc: مثال: تبدو رقيقا نحيفا في ذلك الزي.

other.meaning: having little body fat or flesh; slim; slender; lean; gaunt — see also skinny

paragraph: You always **insist** that you are in the right. You **insist** upon our taking that course of action. If you **insist** on going alone, please do so.
english: to hold up a claim emphatically

other.meaning: to demand that something be done
